queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT ra.name, SUM(r.points) AS total
  FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  GROUP BY ra.name
),
m AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS mean FROM t),
sel AS (SELECT t.name, t.total, m.mean FROM t, m WHERE t.total > m.mean)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(total) FROM sel),
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name IN (SELECT name FROM sel)),
  (SELECT AVG(total - mean) FROM sel);
SELECT AVG(avg_laps)
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM qualifying)
  GROUP BY ra.name
);
SELECT AVG(total_laps) FROM (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.laps) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM qualifying) GROUP BY r.name);
SELECT AVG(total) FROM (
  SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM races r
  JOIN results s ON s.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
);
SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT r.name, COALESCE(SUM(res.points), 0) AS total FROM races r LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name);
